scope: Offline static review of installed-equivalent Mir Pay 1.65.1.350 recovered payload, exported entrypoints, and current primary Android HCE documentation. No hardware, backend, payment data, token requests, app patching or permission bypass.

sdk_conclusion: No APDU submission command is exposed among the eight parsed SDK command cases. Exported=true on SdkHostService does not turn the local HCE engine into an external relay API. In-app Intent dispatch does not process contactless terminal APDUs.

android_primary_sources.finding: BIND_NFC_SERVICE ensures only the OS can bind/communicate; incoming APDUs come from the OS NFC controller path.
Protection level signature; only system can bind to HostApduService/OffHostApduService.

practical_result: On an ordinary unprivileged Android application, no supported path was found to feed the band BLE APDUs into the installed Mir Pay phone HCE engine. Building the transport succeeded; an explicit supported Mir Pay external-transport API or authorized vendor integration is a separate prerequisite. This is not a claim of physical impossibility with different software/OS or extra hardware.
limitations: Static decompilation can omit malformed/protected paths; SDK dispatch examined specifically, not a mathematical proof across every native byte.
